boundary_condition.note: Theorem statements summarize procedural behavior demonstrated within CASE_FAMILY_V1. They do not assert universal claims about all systems, all models, or all domains.

theorems.note: Divergence between agents is replayable without requiring agreement.
Clean source receipts do not imply a correct derived claim.
Two authenticated receipts can describe an impossible combined history.
Applicability in one domain does not transfer without a valid receipt.
A historically valid receipt can be temporally stale without being false.
Procedural conformance does not imply substantive correctness or truth.
A HOLD state indicates incomplete receipts, not system failure.
Procedural closure does not grant epistemic or policy authority.
Multiple agents do not constitute multiple independent evidence sources.
